checks.check: Pack creatures (warm orange family) and humans (pale bone) are immediately distinguishable from each other and from the floor in every frame where both appear.
The three pack creatures read as three DIFFERENT kinds (bright ember orange / deep rust / pale amber), not three copies. If no frame shows all three, judge from the frames that show two.

In frames with multiple pack creatures, exactly one reads as 'the one I control' (brighter + white outline). If no frame shows more than one pack creature, mark pass=false with why='not exercised by this script'.

Across the swap frames, the white possession ring appears on a DIFFERENT pack creature before vs after — possession visibly moved. If the script never shows a swap, mark pass=false with why='not exercised by this script'.
Creatures carry a small dark notch on the edge they face — you can tell which way a body points in a static frame.
At least one frame shows a small pale shot in flight, clearly separate from any creature body. If the script never fires one, mark pass=false with why='not exercised by this script'.
Human attack telegraph (red edge + yellow core swell) reads as incoming danger and is clearly distinct from the gold gate/transition tiles.

No pack creature's damage flash reads as WHITE (white reads as a spawn/holy effect); pack hurt-flash must read crimson/red. Judge only frames where a pack creature is mid-flash; if none, mark pass=true with why='not exercised'.

In at least one frame after a kill, a faded remnant of the fallen body is visible where it fell (fights leave history). If no post-kill frame exists, mark pass=false with why='not exercised by this script'.
The HUD shows three stacked kit-colored bars; the possessed one is wider with a white edge. Bars plausibly track the fight shown.
Nest frames (warm dark organic) and district frames (gray concrete city blocks) read as different places at a glance.
No frame shows tearing, missing map, entities outside walls, or obviously corrupted output.
If a wipe frame is present, it reads as a run-ending event (dark veil + large text), distinct from ordinary combat frames. If the script never wipes, mark pass=true with why='not exercised'.

When special frames are present, Blocker reads as a heavy ring shock, Lobber as delayed targeted tiles, and Striker as a bright through-lane. The three effects must not look like one reused attack effect. If this replay has no special frames, pass with why='not exercised by this script'.

When Volley target tiles are present, their pack-orange outlined countdown is clearly different from both the human red-edge/yellow-core danger telegraph and the solid gold zone gate. If absent, pass with why='not exercised by this script'.
When a pack mark is present, one human has a clear reticle glyph that does not resemble the possession ring or attack tiles. If absent, pass with why='not exercised by this script'.

All three HUD bars have a stable special pip. When special casts are present, the relevant body's pip visibly changes from ready to spent while the other bodies retain their own state; if no special is cast in this replay, pass based on all three pips being present and note that tracking was not exercised.

When glean drops are present (small magenta/violet squares centered on floor tiles), they read as desirable pickups, clearly distinct from corpses, projectiles, human telegraphs, the teal mark reticle, and the gold gate tiles. If a near-expiry drop is visible its fade reads as decay, not a render bug. If this replay shows no drops, pass with why='not exercised by this script'.

When the possessed carries value, a small magenta numeral reads at the right end of the possessed HUD bar row and appears nowhere else on the HUD; frames without carrying show the identical bar layout minus the numeral (no layout shift). If carrying never occurs in this replay, pass with why='not exercised by this script'.

When nest frames include the station fixture (hollow-centered magenta-toned block), it reads as a distinct interactable place — not a wall, not the gold gate. When the possessed stands within ~2 tiles of it, a banked-total numeral is legible above the fixture. If the replay never shows the station, pass with why='not exercised by this script'.
